content: Able neis lede detauti paretkak taba kaimegizem nalu akaidari gabge, a wi azigmadariei Ople nali nade e able areto itrida.
Nade e wiabi detagerda tabara memegle, bazigmarti Ople epedali iabidoge. “Mapodan wabim,” e etkarti.
Iaba geum barukda ableglam wi dikepwarda e namar dali.
E no etkarlu iabim, “Naluglam wa geumge bakeli? Naluglam able adud idoni taba wabi akepwarge?
“Dasmer kara tag a teter, a wa umele kakanali. Wa kara gem itutrare waiakai wa umele ka nole namar nali. Kara gem a kara lid; namar nolekar.
Ege tabara tag a teter natometare tabara memegle.
Au serer barukda, wi nalu waikaidarda, abi nautmerda, “Wa asreda gair lu arwem able utebge?”
Wi abi wib lar ikwarda, e irwi iabi opem.
Ege iabi etkarlu kega, “Able orwaiorwai lu peike kaka detauti wabim ka iaka nawer iabidoge; gair lu dautarer ga Gelar Mosera, ge daurarer peropetara a pako Samge, otaba agekar obai.”
E iaba idoni bauskilu wige Zogoziawali dimirwartare.
E wabim etkarlu, “Able mir bautarda: Able Mesaiade asiasi digi, ege ekiamda eudlam neis a netat gergerge.
“Lu ma abra mir ais etomeret meriba wit mir waditaut Ierusalamage a gair le pe uridli able gesepge.
“Wa dasmeri able mir e barkak mir dike.”
